get_credit_balance.title: Get the credit balance
get_credit_balance.description: Read how many enrichment credits the account has left. The cheapest call that proves the API key works, and the one to run before submitting a batch you cannot afford to have half-finish.

enrich_leads.title: Enrich a batch of leads
enrich_leads.description: Submit 1-100 leads for waterfall email and phone enrichment. Each lead needs a first and last name plus either `company` or `company_domain`; `linkedin_url` sharply improves the hit rate. Returns a `request_id` only -- poll get_enrichment_results, or set `webhook` and be told. Phone enrichment needs the add-on, and `verify_catch_all` adds a deliverability pass on catch-all domains.

data.description: The leads to enrich, 1-100 of them. Each is {"first_name": ..., "last_name": ..., "company" or "company_domain": ..., optionally "linkedin_url" and "custom_fields": {...}}. `custom_fields` is echoed back untouched, which is how you match results to your own records.

enrich_email_address.description: Look for the work email address. Defaults to true.

enrich_phone_number.description: Look for the mobile number. Requires the phone add-on on the account.

enrich_profile.description: Also return the contact's LinkedIn profile -- headline, seniority, skills.

verify_catch_all.description: Run the extra verification pass on catch-all domains, at extra cost.

webhook.description: Url to POST the whole result to as soon as the request finishes.

contact_webhook.description: Url to POST each lead to individually. Only used with `push_contact_individually`.

push_contact_individually.description: Push each lead to `contact_webhook` as it completes, rather than waiting for all.

process_flow.description: Identifier of a specific provider flow to use for this request.

timeout_seconds.description: How long the waterfall may run before the request is cut short.

output.description: The submitted request, with the `request_id` to poll.

get_enrichment_results.title: Get enrichment results
get_enrichment_results.description: Read the results of an enrichment request by id. The response carries a request-level status plus a per-lead one, so a request that reports finished may still hold leads that were not found -- check both. Poll this until the request is done, or use a webhook instead.

request_id.description: The request id returned by enrich_leads.

output.description: The request's status and its per-lead results.

enrich_lead_profile.title: Enrich one person's profile
enrich_lead_profile.description: Look one person up and get their profile and current company back inline -- no polling. `linkedin_url` alone is enough; without it, give first name, last name and `company_domain`.

linkedin_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile url. Sufficient on its own.

first_name.description: First name. Required when `linkedin_url` is not given.

last_name.description: Last name. Required when `linkedin_url` is not given.

company_domain.description: Company domain. Required when `linkedin_url` is not given.

company.description: Company name, which complements but cannot replace `company_domain`.

output.description: The person's profile and current company.

enrich_company_profile.title: Enrich a company profile
enrich_company_profile.description: Look one company up by domain or LinkedIn page and get its profile back inline -- industry, size, location and description.

company_domain.description: Company website or domain. Use this or `company_linkedin_url`.

company_linkedin_url.description: Company LinkedIn page url. Use this or `company_domain`.

find_leads.title: Search for new leads
find_leads.description: Search BetterContact's data for people matching company and person criteria -- prospecting rather than enrichment. `filters` is an object of filter keys, each taking {"include": [...], "exclude": [...]}, e.g. {"company_industry": {"include": ["Software"]}, "lead_seniority": {"include": ["director"]}}. Taxonomy filters must use BetterContact's own values exactly or they match nothing. Asynchronous: poll get_lead_finder_results with the returned id.

filters.description: Search criteria. At least one value is required. Company-side keys include company, company_industry, company_hq_location, company_technologies, company_keywords, company_headcount_min/max, revenue_ranges and last_funding_round_names; person-side keys include lead_job_title, lead_seniority, lead_department, lead_location and lead_skills. Each takes {"include": [...], "exclude": [...]}.

limit.description: Leads to return for this page (1-200).

offset.description: Zero-based number of leads to skip before returning matches.

max_leads.description: Total leads to return when not paginating. Defaults to 100.

webhook.description: Url to POST the results to when the search finishes.

enrich_email_address.description: Also run each found lead through email enrichment, at extra credit cost.

enrich_phone_number.description: Also run each found lead through phone enrichment. Needs the phone add-on.

output.description: The submitted search, with the `request_id` to poll.

get_lead_finder_results.title: Get lead search results
get_lead_finder_results.description: Read the leads a Lead Finder search found, by request id. Poll until the search reports finished, or supply a webhook when submitting it.

request_id.description: The request id returned by find_leads.

output.description: The search's status and the leads it found.
